description: This source file implements the Android-specific proxy configuration service for Chromium, handling proxy settings retrieval, override, and change notifications via JNI integration.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::Delegate
classes.description: Manages JNI interactions, proxy configuration updates, and observer notifications on the main and JNI threads.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::JNIDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implements JNI callback methods to handle proxy setting changes from Java.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::ProxyConfigServiceAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing JNI setup and fetching initial proxy configuration.

methods.name: set_exclude_pac_url
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude PAC URL from proxy configuration.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChangedTo
methods.description: Updates proxy settings to specified host, port, PAC URL, and exclusions.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChanged
methods.description: Notifies that proxy settings have changed.

methods.name: SetProxyOverride
methods.description: Overrides proxy settings with specified rules and bypass list.
